senses.gloss: f. (reduplic. of דוי or דוע; cmp. אוּדְיָיתָא) the vapor room.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 67a:1">Nidd. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>אימר בד׳ נפל</he> Ar. s. v. <cite ref="A00380"><he>אדוותא</he></cite> (ed. <cite ref="T00254"><he>רדיוני</he></cite>) I say, it (the mud) fell off in the vapor room (where she entered after the bath).
